Open the deck [in its own tab](../../live/housing-one-day.html){target="_blank"} for the full screen, the speaker view and the keyboard controls: the `d` key switches the optional runs of slides on and off, `[` and `]` jump between parts, and `g` opens a jump bar that finds a slide by its title. The cells of its hands-on slides run R inside your browser once the engine has loaded, so the deck shows each step of the tasks with its output, and it carries the work if your installation fails.
